core.verify.note: Verification is client-core's, which the Node SDK consumes directly; the Node runner drives it on Node 22 and again on the engines.node floor (CI node-floor).

except.note: When @napi-rs/keyring cannot load (a single-executable build, no Secret Service) the token is in a 0600 file; supports() reports dependency (P1b-10).

core.store.note: KeyringStore by default; an Electron main process uses SafeStorageStore (@polaris-key/node/electron), whose status() reports keyring-unavailable when safeStorage cannot encrypt or falls back to basic_text, and keyring-error when the stored token no longer decrypts (SP-N11).

core.copy.note: copy.message/title/activation over src/copy.generated.ts (pnpm gen:constants, from conformance/parity/copy.en.json): the error-code, gate and activation tables, COPY_FALLBACK naming an unknown code; registerCopy adds a locale that falls back to the generated English per key.

license.manage.note: PX-W8: the device-limit result exposes manageUrl (validated), plus the return and key helpers.

license.refusals.note: activationRefusal maps every refusal by its body code (activateWithKey, enroll, token): each kind carries the wire code, an unknown 4xx is refused{code}.

config.mirror.note: The TypeScript mirror is rendered by tools/gen-mirrors.ts.

config.local.note: client.config.set/clear/setting and onConfigChange: persisted in the state directory, validated against the catalog type, refused for an admin-managed key, with per-key and wildcard change events (SP-N13).

telemetry.updates.note: The update-health journal (<stateDir>/update-events.json) rides devices/report as updates: at most 16 per report, oldest first, dropped once a 200 delivered them.

devices.attest.note: P6-02: a Node process has no platform attestation service; its devices stay at the basic trust level.

identity.oidc.note: Browser redirect sign-in for native hosts waits on I-15's redirect token route (wire item W4); /identity/auth/poll is deprecated and never used. The interim is identity.signInWithBrowser(): device code opened in the system browser (SDK parity pass §3.12).

identity.devicelabel.note: PX-W13: the label (client-core normalizeDeviceLabel, the deviceName option, os.hostname() without .local/.lan/.home by default) on beginSignIn, activateWithKey and register; SignInPrompt.deviceName is the Worker's echo.

release.record.note: client.update.releaseRecord(hash) and decide() over client-core's verifyReleaseRecord: hash before signature, pinned release keys only; persisted in the releaseRecords cache slice while a committed feed pins it.

release.fetch.note: client.release.fetch(target, {to}): discovery builds route, device bearer and metadata headers, <to>.part resumed with Range and If-Range on the payload SHA-256, size and SHA-256 checked against the verified record before the rename.

release.distribution.note: client.distribution.downloadModel() and thisPlatform(): the public download model, no bearer.

update.feed.note: client.update.feed() and decide() over client-core's verifyFeed; the feeds cache slice is keyed by the canonical channel and re-verified on load, so each seq floor survives a restart.

update.feeds.note: client.update.feedUrl(kind): appcast, winsparkle, velopack (the feed directory without a Velopack channel), appInstaller and zsync from discovery update.endpoints, a channel alias rewritten first; a missing template is the typed unsupported (product).

update.decide.note: client.update.decide() over client-core's runUpdateCheck; the outlet is the host's update.outlet, else the in-process detection result (P3-11) over the stamp, and is unknown, never offered an update, with no stamp and no attested evidence.

update.content.note: client-core decideUpdate with content (feedContent, selectPackRows, prestage, the content blocks and boot required for revoked required content); client.update.decide() builds content from the content stamp, the pack state, the variant preferences and the stored revocations (runUpdateCheck steps 10-14).

update.driver.note: client.update.install(decision) answers an InstallOutcome (restartRequired, handedOff, storeOpened, unsupported{reason}) through the configured driver: electronUpdaterDriver (the found version must equal the signed decision's and the downloaded file must hash to an artifact of its record), velopackDriver (the discovery Velopack feed), seaSelfReplaceDriver (release.fetch-verified bytes, <exe>.previous kept as the boot guard's rollback) and storeLinkDriver, under @polaris-key/node/update/drivers/*; none imports its updater (SP-N09).

update.bootguard.note: client.update.markBootAttempt() / confirmBoot() over client-core's bootGuardAction: slots in <stateDir>/boot-guard.json, a rollback through the install driver's hook (else boot_rolled_back with code no-previous and the version kept as skipVersion), update_confirmed / update_reverted / boot_rolled_back in the update-health journal (SP-N06).

outlet.detect.note: client-core's detectOutlet over this process's signals (src/update/outlet.ts readOutletSignals: environment, executable and script path conventions, isSea, Electron's mas and windowsStore, product-named markers); the update client detects when the host names no outlet. The P1-11 build stamp (.polaris_key/build.json) is autoloaded when the host passes none; Windows SignatureKind is read on request through PowerShell's WinRT projection (readWindowsSignatureKind, SP-N15).

crash.tags.note: client.crashTags() / crashTagsFor(): release <deliverable>@<version>[+<build>], environment the channel, pkey.outlet the outlet, as the Worker Sentry hook parses them.

packs.record.note: client-core verifyReleaseRecord with pin.kind (pack records fetched by the content stamp's pin) and verifyMarker for embedded baselines; the Node runner drives every packRecordCases and markerCases vector.

packs.revoke.note: client-core verifyRevocation and newerRevocation; the PackEngine keeps verified revocations in the sibling revocations.json (revocationsStored, relearn, 256 targets) and refuses revoked mounts with pack-revoked.

packs.delegation.note: client-core verifyReleaseRecord (the delegated path, steps 13 and 16), verifyDelegation, recordRevoked and dataOnlyRefusal; the PackEngine fetches and caches delegations, refuses non-data-only delegated installs with pack-not-data-only, stores PackInstall.delegation and refuses releases under a revoked delegation (pack-revoked, detail delegation); the Node runner drives every delegationCases and dataOnlyCases vector.

packs.plan.note: client-core plan, selectVariant and planTarget; every plan-matrix.json row, variant case and target case in the Node runner.

packs.index.files.note: client-core parseFilesIndex, checkPaths and treeDigest; filesIndexCases under the WASM decoder, node:zlib and a failed probe.

packs.index.chunks.note: client-core parseChunkIndex (u64 as two u32 reads, saturated at 2^53; every chunks-* code); all 22 chunkIndexCases under the WASM decoder, node:zlib and a failed probe; the PackEngine keeps each installed payload's index under <packs>/index/<sha256> and re-verifies it on use.

packs.apply.full.note: client-core applyFull (streamed through node:zlib when it has zstd); applyCases under every backend.

packs.apply.file.note: client-core applyFile with the type-neutral container rebuild; applyCases under every backend.

packs.apply.chunk.note: client-core applyChunk (seeds across packs and embedded baselines, the planner's runs, one single-range request per run with If-Range on the bundle hash and the exact Content-Range rule, the repair pass) over DirPackStorage: staging/<planId>/journal.json run bitmap and resume, fallback when a server ignores Range; the 8 chunk applyCases under every backend; chunk is in caps.strategies.

packs.apply.delta.note: node:zlib for --patch-from frames when its start-up probe decodes, else @polaris-key/zstd-wasm (Node 22.0-22.14 have no zstd; 22.15-22.18 ignore the dictionary); the window check runs in the applier whatever the decoder.

packs.delta.feed.note: client-core: feedContent reads the feed's deltas menu, withFeedDeltas merges it into the selected variant before planTarget, and PackEngine tries at most one feed-offered delta per install (fallback on a 404 or any delta verdict), journalling it as feedDelta for resume; update/client.ts wires feedDeltas to the committed feed (fresh or stale).

packs.state.note: client-core's install-state machine and PackEngine over DirPackStorage in the platform data directory: journal, resume with Range/If-Range, atomic pointer swap, confirm, rollback, GC roots, embedded baselines; packSetId on devices/report.

packs.handlers.note: client.update.packs.registerHandler; files.tree (hot: versioned directory plus pointer swap), data.json and l10n.table built in; check(staged) refuses a staged payload with pack-type-check-failed before it commits (P4-16); custom.<name> through registerHandler.

packs.type.godot.zip.note: P4-16: a godot.zip is mounted only by Godot's load_resource_pack.

packs.type.l10n.table.note: P4-16: L10nTableHandler, built in: PO, CSV or JSON tables parsed by plain parsers (never evaluated), each table's BCP-47 locale matched to the variant's locale axis; hot; tables(packId) and onActivate/onDeactivate.

packs.type.data.json.note: P4-16: DataJsonHandler, built in: every file strict JSON with an object at the top, whatever its name; formatVersions the host lists (default [1]); hot; documents(packId) and onActivate/onDeactivate.

packs.type.audio.bank.note: P4-16: audio banks load through a game engine's middleware.

packs.type.ml.model.note: P4-16: MlModelHandler, registered by the host with its runtimes, RAM/VRAM budget, quantisations and load test: model.json checked, the staged file load-tested, then model(packId) swaps; hot.

packs.transport.steam.note: P5-08 covers Godot only; Node desktop hosts have no Steam-depot transport owner.

packs.transport.msix.note: No work package owns the MSIX optional-package transport (P5-08 Out).

packs.transport.flatpak.note: No work package owns the Flatpak extension transport (P5-08 Out).

ui.stages.note: BOOT_STAGES, bootTransition, bootGuardAction and the rest re-exported from client-core; client.boot({onStage}) drives the machine end to end and client.ensureActivated() runs its first three stages (SP-N05).

ui.boot.note: client.boot(): discovery, the keyless registration when the product is open and no token is held, the sync pass, then the client-core stage machine to its outcome (SP-N05).

ui.cli.note: @polaris-key/node/cli, the terminal kit (UK-14): every CLI_VERBS verb runs a rail flow (masked key entry, browser or code sign-in, spinners and progress, OSC 8 links and OSC 52 copy, the half-block QR for offline requests), --json on every verb, grouped help and bash/zsh/fish completion, for commander and yargs. Proven by test/cli/golden.test.ts (every component x state in truecolor dark and light, ANSI-16, NO_COLOR and ASCII at 80 and 60 columns, with SVG and PNG baselines) and test/cli/kit.test.ts; the plain command core keeps one test per verb (SP-N14).

commerce.receipt.note: client.commerce: binding(), claim(store, payload) and the store helpers claimSteam(ticketHex, dlcAppId), claimAppStore(jws), claimPlay(productId, token). No store SDK dependency: the host passes what its store handed it (SDK parity pass §3.9, SP-N04).
